body:
Adds bounded phase observations from the owners of preparation, Run custody and publication. Missing and incomplete intervals remain explicit; observations from different clocks are never added into a total. Read-only projections retain exact Run or actor/revision scope.

Qualified head `6f6b7e8a76e0c14423154768f3742b43aafbb042`: lifecycle completed all 168 steps, full Python discovery passed 1,636 tests with 72 skips, and the PostgreSQL phase gate passed 14 tests without skips. Actual existing browser and one-fit gates passed; completed-log and source reviews are clear. The timing panel belongs to the dependent PR104. Retargeting to main changes history only: the base and prospective merge trees equal the qualified trees. No device, numerical-quality or end-to-end performance claim is added.
